Fan feedback labelled "Top Deck 13 / Row B • Baseball", titled "Great for scenery, but not for the game": "Even when sitting in the front rows of the Top Deck sections, the views still feel noticeably high and far. I was in Row B which was the second row from the front of Top Deck Section 13, and the views of the field were very aerial when looking so far down to the playing surface. A guard railing at the front of our section started to cross into my line of sight just beyond third base, and muddled my view leading down the left field line. I was glad I wasn't in the front row of the section (Row A), as the railing was probably far worse of an issue from there. But the one thing I really enjoy about sitting on the Top Deck is the views of the landscapes and mountains in the background of Dodger Stadium. There's no better place to be to check out the surrounding scenery than the concourses and seats of the Top Deck." OBSTRUCTION SIGNAL: guard railing at the front of the section, worst in Row A. This review also implies section 13TD looks down the LEFT FIELD line past third base, but the page states no side explicitly.
